text: Sorry to disturb at this hour. My granddaughter, 8 years, fever is 39.1. She vomited one time in the evening but after that she has kept down water and juice, no problem. But I think something is not right. She is very sleepy, not like her normal self at all. When I call her name she is not answering properly, only opening her eyes a little bit and then going back. Normally she is very lively child, talking talking whole time. I am not sure if this is only because of fever or something more, maybe I am worrying too much but I am really very scared. Please kindly tell what to do, should we take her to hospital now itself?
